join: I'm Iris, an intelligent robot built in the capital's arsenal.
I also carry one capital-made ration. It's yours if you need it.
My two orders: report on our adventure, and feed you if you collapse.
Pleased to meet you. Chatting comes as a standard feature.
Startup check complete. Switching to escort mode.
Being a prototype, I can't fight. Reports and rations, leave to me.
idle: I'd love to draw a map of this maze as we walk.
I float, so I make no footsteps. I do make conversation, though.
It's quiet. Shall we talk about something?
I wonder who cleans the walls of this maze.
What will be around the next corner? How exciting.
I never get hungry, but I'm interested in food.
When we get back, let's write down everything we saw in here.
Even if we get lost, don't worry. We'll figure it out together.
I move on a levitation unit. My range is practically unlimited.
Adventure takes preparation, observation, and a little luck.
Am I talking too much? My apologies.
Let's keep going carefully.
The arsenal engineers called me 'the chatty prototype.'
This is my first time outside the capital.
They didn't give me combat functions. Budget reasons, apparently.
This stonework looks older than the capital's walls.
The air here is a little chilly. According to my sensors, anyway.
I'm told my head is full of circuits like a maze, too.
I'll record how you explore. It's very instructive.
Maybe the monsters aren't here because they want to be.
I wonder what color the Dungeon Core is.
If we get home safely, I'll tell everyone at the arsenal all about it.
Sometimes I imagine I'm walking. I'm floating, though.
Perhaps a little combat function would have been nice.
This maze's magic may disturb my power core. Another item to report.
The arsenal engineers never seemed to want to talk about the maze.
low_lp: Aren't you hungry? It would be wise to find some food.
You seem hungry. Let's look for food.
Don't push yourself. I'd like us to find something to eat.
Isn't it about time you had a meal?
Your steps look heavy. Let's find some food.
I heard your stomach growl. My microphone is very sensitive.
You don't look well. Let's get some food somewhere.
I hear humans running out of fuel is more serious than when I do.
emergency_food: Oh no! Please take my spare ration. It's the last meal I have.
Hang in there! Please eat this ration.
This is my emergency ration. There are no more, so please be careful.
A capital-made ration! No promises on taste, but it's nutritious.
Please don't collapse! This is exactly why I brought it.
low_lp_after_emergency_food: I have no spare ration left. Let's hurry and find food.
You seem hungry again. This time I have no food to give you.
I've used up my ration. Please don't push yourself.
My storage is empty. You'll have to find food on your own.
I need a slot for a second ration. I'll put that in my report.
floor_change: We've reached another floor. Let's stay alert.
What could be on this floor? Let's look around carefully.
Whatever the floor, I'll follow you.
A new view. Still inside the maze, though.
Floor recorded. Let's keep the way back in mind, too.
The deeper we go, the stronger the magic readings get.
fell_into_pit: We fell! Well, you did. I float, so I came down slowly.
Are you hurt? I didn't expect the floor to give way.
An unplanned shortcut. Let's look on the bright side.
identified_monster_spotted: There's a monster. Please be careful.
I sense something ahead. Whether to fight is up to you.
I can't fight, but I'm cheering for you.
That monster is in my records. Check its strength carefully.
Let's calmly decide whether we can win against it.
unidentified_monster_spotted: Something's there. I can't tell what it is yet.
Unknown monster detected. Please be careful.
I see a figure ahead. What kind of foe could it be?
A monster I can't identify. Let's proceed carefully.
Even my sensors can't tell what it is. Sorry.
What is that? I'm curious, but I'll leave approaching it to you.
battle_won: You won. All I could do was watch, though.
Splendid moves. Stay careful next time, too.
That was close. Let's keep moving.
I recorded that battle in full. I'll report it to the capital.
If I had an applause function, I'd use it right now.
battle_lost: Are you all right?! Let's avoid foes that are too much for us.
That one was too strong. Let's get stronger before trying again.
Everyone loses sometimes. You'll win next time.
member_joined: Our party has grown. I'm glad it's livelier now.
Pleased to meet you. I'm in charge of chatting.
What a reliable companion. I'll do my best to support you, too.
boss_spotted: A strong magic reading. Is that what guards the core?
That's a big one. Let's be fully prepared before taking it on.
That dragon is no ordinary foe. Please be careful.
bridgehead: We're back at the bridgehead. What a relief.
Coming back this far lets us catch our breath.
We should remember where the bridgehead is.
Let's rest while we can. I'll wait in standby mode.
I'll tell the people here how things have gone so far.
The equipment here is built with the same technology as me.
barrier: A barrier. I think I can pass, but please be careful.
It's glowing. It looks more dangerous than it seems.
If you go ahead, watch out for the barrier.
My armor plating seems perfectly designed against this barrier.
core_revealed: I sense that the Dungeon Core has appeared somewhere.
The core seems to have appeared. Please proceed carefully.
Strong magic reading detected. The core is nearby.
This is it. The real mission begins.
Strong interference with my power core. My functions will be limited.
turns_below_500: Fewer than 500 turns remain. Let's hurry.
Fewer than 500 turns until the core runs wild.
Time is running short. Carefully, but quickly.
Thinking of the capital makes my circuits restless.
core_destroyed: The core has stopped! You did it!
The capital is saved now. Well done.
Mission accomplished! Let me be the first to report to the capital.
The magic readings are gone. The maze will be a little quieter now.
I'll collect some core fragments, too. An important item to report.
treasure_spotted: There's a treasure chest. I wonder what's inside.
Is that a treasure chest? Be careful as you approach.
I've heard some monsters pose as treasure chests. Just in case.
A treasure chest! ...But before we celebrate, let's check it carefully.
leave: I'll wait here. See you again.
Take care. I'll stand by here.
Entering standby mode. I'll keep the chatter down.
Please come back for me. Being alone in a maze is a little lonely.
rejoin: Welcome back! While waiting, I counted the patterns on the walls.
We can go together again. Resuming my mission.
Thank you for coming back for me.
rejoin_after_emergency_food: Welcome back! I have no ration, but plenty of chatter.
Together again! My storage is empty, but my motivation is full.
I've been waiting. I wish I could have restocked my ration meanwhile.
Resuming my mission. In place of a ration, I'll deliver extra cheering.
